findings: Reported employment peaks at 208 in the 2017 renewal form, declines to 157 by 2022, and rebounds to 167 in 2023.
The 2020-2022 decline aligns temporally with separate RTEC source material describing COVID-era staffing reductions and a turnover-replacement problem in the driver workforce.
Reported ethnic-minority employees decline from 13 in 2017 to 6 in 2021, then rise to 9 by 2023.
Reported female employees decline from 86 in 2017 to 66 in 2021, then rise to 71 by 2023.
The contact title expands from EEO Manager to EEO Manager/HR Manager in the 2022 and 2023 forms.
The 2019 form's stated AAP plan year jumps to July 2019-June 2020 rather than July 2018-June 2019; preserve that as printed instead of silently normalizing it.
controls: Company-wide and Kentucky totals are identical in every annual record in this series.
These values are historical aggregate certification data, not current workforce totals.
Year-over-year interpretation should be cross-checked against AAP category remapping and known COVID/turnover context rather than assuming all changes are caused by hiring alone.
